```{r, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

readRenviron("C:/Users/BoydClaire/.Renviron")

table_data <- read.csv("data/building_classifications.csv")
```

The table below includes a list of the building classifications and their corresponding
descriptions, use, tax class, and model codes.

***Note***: Each observation is a unique combination of BC, TC, USE, and MODEL so if
there are duplicate BCs it is because they correspond to multiple TCs or MODELs.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

DT::datatable(table_data, escape = FALSE, filter = 'top', rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(paging = FALSE, scrollCollapse = TRUE
              ))
```
